text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Non-criminal record report * 2. Notarized Highest Diploma (High school certificate) Prospective diploma winners must submit official document issued by your current school to prove your current student status or expected graduation date. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. * 3. Academic transcripts (written in Chinese or English) Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. * 4. Financial Statement: Evidence of financial support 5. Others: all kinds of certificates, including sports, arts and other relevant certificates, are warmly welcome. * 6. CV Your CV must be up to date, covering all your experiences, including education and employment experience. * 7. If you are not in China, please provide the Physical Examination form. If you are already in China, the valid visa page is required The physical examinations must cover all the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form. Incomplete forms or forms without the signature of the attending physician, or the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicant are considered as invalid. Please carefully plan your physical examination schedule as the result is valid for only 6 months. Pleases keep the original copy of the Form for school registration. You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 9. English proficiency certificate * 10. One photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 11. Personal Statement Please write your personal introduction and study plan in your personal statement in Chinese or English. * 12. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
